title: Solar-only 1-tonne staged cold store with flat-pack chamber
problem_restatement: Provide solar-only day-and-night power for 1 tonne produce cold storage, maintain chill with insulation, refrigeration and air circulation, in a weatherproof transportable cooperatively assemblable chamber with 1-tonne crate layout.
mechanism_sentence: Sunlight from about 10 m2 of panels makes and stores electricity that runs a small cooler blowing cold air around vented crates inside a thick insulated box, cooling about 333 kg of fresh produce per day down to 5 degC.
decisive_choices: Stage 1 tonne harvest over 3 days at about 333 kg per day to fit 8 kWh per day solar and battery
Use variable-speed 1.0 kW DC cooling at COP about 2 with fan-forced evaporator for staged pull-down plus 185 W leak
Build 100 mm PU sandwich chamber at U about 0.22 with 2.2 kW array and 5.12 kWh store for night hold
open_question: Will overnight electrical use with realistic duty cycling plus door-opening infiltration stay within the 5.12 kWh store during staged pull-down?
transfer_line: Energy: 4x550W solar array -> 48V battery bank -> DC cooling unit | Measured: Temperature logger -> MPPT meter

assumed_constraints.constraint: Fixed tilt ~ latitude facing equator, ground mount with airflow gap for cooling
Hold 5 degC and 85-95 % Relative Humidity, where Relative Humidity means moist air fraction, avoiding chilling injury below tropical range
Washable food-safe interior with drain and 20 kg single-person lift limit for safe cooperative handling and cleaning

functional_decomposition: Provide solar-only electrical power day and night for 1 tonne cold storage
Maintain 1 tonne produce at chill temperature with insulation, refrigeration and air circulation
Provide weatherproof insulated chamber, load-bearing frame, door and 1 tonne crate layout that is transportable and cooperatively assemblable

concept.working_principle: Sun makes day electricity stored in battery for night; battery runs variable-speed DC vapour-compression cooler with fan-forced evaporator inside 100mm PU box; staged daily lots of ~333 kg plus 185 W wall leak set ~1.0 kW cooling at COP ~2 drawing 662 W peak; cold air circulates around vented crates on side racks with central aisle to hold 5 degC and 85-95% RH.

fabrication_steps.description: Set raised galvanized skid with plywood spreaders, bolt corner posts and roof rails, set ground anchors
Hand-lock 960mm PU panels to form 2.4x2.0x2.2m box, fit 800mm door with double magnetic gaskets and rain canopy
Fit side slatted racks with 50mm guard rails and central aisle, load 50x 600x400mm 20kg vented crates stacked 5 high
Mount 4x550W array on ground beside room and roof rails, wire MPPT 150V 60A controller to 48V 100Ah bank
Install variable-speed DC unit with fan-forced evaporator and condensate drain, commission staged 3-day pull-down with outside sort and FIFO

risks.risk: One-shot 1-tonne pull-down of 25 kWh exceeds solar day and battery
risks.mitigation: Stage loading over 3 days at ~333 kg per day with outside sort

risks.risk: Running 662 W peak all night empties battery
risks.mitigation: Run steady 157 W hold with duty cycling; night need ~1.88-4 kWh within 5.12 kWh store

risks.risk: Warm air infiltration and spoilage spread from damaged produce
risks.mitigation: 800 mm door with double gaskets, 3 mm squeeze, brief openings for 1-2 crates and FIFO rotation

novelty_claim: Flat-pack cam-lock insulated chamber on steel skid with roof array rails combining 1.0 kW variable-speed DC cooling, 50x20 kg vented crates on side racks with aisle, and 3-day staged loading with outside sort and FIFO to fit 2.2 kW solar and 5.12 kWh store

figure_spec.system_view: Insulated chamber on steel skid with door, racks, crates, central aisle and roof solar rails, with evaporator fan and condensate drain

open_questions: Will overnight electrical use with realistic duty cycling plus door-opening infiltration stay within the 5.12 kWh store during staged pull-down?
